control.title: Code review and branch protection
control.description: Require peer review and passing checks before merging to main branches, enforced through branch protection.

evidence_hint: Branch protection settings and sample reviewed pull requests.
acceptance_criteria: Branch protection requires review before merge on main branches
Sample pull requests show approval by someone other than the author

criteria_coverage.criterion: Branch protection requires review before merge on main branches
Sample pull requests show approval by someone other than the author

automation.name: Bitbucket Cloud
tests: Main branches require an approval and block direct pushes

automation.name: GitHub
tests: Default branches require pull request review

automation.name: GitLab
tests: Default branches protected; no direct pushes by developers
Merge requests need at least one approval

requirements.title: Code review, VA and PT at least annually and before deployment
requirements.guidance: Source code review, VA and PT at least annually in authenticated mode, vendor certificates for code you don't own, security audit before any deployment, and recurring findings reported to the sub-committee.

requirements.title: Change management
requirements.guidance: Authorise, design, test, approve and implement changes to infrastructure, data and software.
